description: Phase 6as gate — UNION ALL / UNION / EXCEPT / INTERSECT with heterogeneous column types across branches. Relaxes any per-column type-equality assumption to allow, e.g. INTEGER in branch 1 + TEXT in branch 2 to both appear in the unified result.

program.sql: SELECT v FROM t1 UNION ALL SELECT v FROM t2 ORDER BY v;
SELECT v FROM t1 UNION ALL SELECT v FROM t2;

cases.name: union-hetero-dedup-strict-equality
cases.description: UNION (with dedup) dedups by strict value equality — 1 and '1' are NOT duplicates.

cases.name: union-integer-and-real-dedup
cases.description: INTEGER 1 and REAL 1.0 DEDUP in UNION — SQLite uses affinity-based (numeric) equality, same as the = operator. The first-seen value is retained.

program.sql: SELECT v FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 'literal' ORDER BY v;

cases.name: intersect-hetero-empty
cases.description: INTERSECT with type-divergent operands produces no intersection (strict equality).

cases.name: except-hetero
cases.description: EXCEPT with type-divergent operands is a no-op subtraction.
